text: OWNER DISPOSITION RECORDED FOR Q5 ITEM 3, from posts post-01M1CN0CHHMYSA93R7AZMPZQB2 and post-01M1CMQA97YSS4VGVCRM281Y0F. This is owner project policy, not legal adjudication or automatic artifact admission. Exact edition/media identity, clocks, 17-source alias mapping, derivation receipts, uncertainty, feature-use, and anti-circularity remain scientific gates.
